annotations.grafana.app/message: PMR-ZV9Y 6.3: run timeline row added — Loki state history (line_format + Extract fields) and Tempo step-span Gantt with span-id links; pi_flow_phase/pi_flow_step tiles; kept tool-error + phase-duration panels on v2 vocabulary

spec.description: All tool calls across the selected refs.
spec.title: Tool calls

spec.description: The phase each selected ticket is IN right now, from the v2 pi_flow_phase gauge (pushed with the run, one series per open phase; a finished run has no line, so an empty tile means nothing is in a phase in the pushed set). Tile = phase + how many tickets are in it. v1 status wording is retired — the vocabulary is state/phase/step.
spec.title: Current phase per ticket ($ref)

spec.description: The registry step(s) each selected ticket is executing right now, from the v2 pi_flow_step gauge (one series per in-flight step; closes on step-stop). Step names follow the <phase>.<step> registry (flow/steps.ts). Empty = no step in flight in the pushed set.
spec.title: Current step per ticket ($ref)

spec.description: Every v2 journal event for the selected tickets, oldest first: state-change (state + reason) and step-start/step-stop (phase + step). THIS IS THE RUN TIMELINE — the sequence of states a ticket passed through, which Prometheus cannot show (it only keeps the current gauge). Written by the session-side Loki pusher (telemetry/loki.ts, fan-out in telemetry/dispatch.ts), so it stays EMPTY until telemetry.loki.enabled points at a reachable Loki; the same events are always in the local journal (~/.pi/agent/pi-flow/runs/<ref>.journal.jsonl). Columns come from line_format + Extract fields, not raw JSON. Time = the event's own `at`.
spec.title: Run state history (Loki) — populates once telemetry.loki.enabled ($ref)

value.title: Runs board: live state for this ticket

spec.description: One row per STEP span (flow.span = "step"), oldest first: the Gantt of what each ticket actually executed, with start time and duration. Click a Span ID to open the trace tree (root -> phase -> step). Step spans come from the session-side OTLP exporter (telemetry/index.ts), so they exist only for runs made with telemetry enabled. Not filtered by $mode: personal traces carry no flow.mode attribute and a =~ match on a missing attribute never hits. Tempo returns at most `spss` spans per trace (20 here) and a finished trace is fully searchable ~3 min after its last span (trace_idle_period).
spec.title: Step timeline (Tempo step spans) — click the Span ID ($ref)

value.title: Runs board: live state for this ticket

spec.description: Failing tool calls. Any error is orange, 10+ red.
spec.title: Tool errors

spec.description: Share of tool calls that failed.
spec.title: Error rate

spec.description: Tickets with pushed phase durations (pi_flow_run_duration_seconds, a kept metric). A ticket with no push never appears here — that is the signal to run /flow-cost <ref> --push.
spec.title: Tickets measured

spec.description: Pushgateway counters are per-run totals — a barchart reads them cleanly; the old timeseries showed push-time step artifacts.
spec.title: Tool calls by tool (ok vs error)

spec.description: Sorted worst-first. Points at the tool/phase combo to fix or guard.
spec.title: Error rate by tool and phase

spec.description: Where the wall-clock time went, per phase (plan / implement / validate / feedback). Durations are phase-start to phase-complete and INCLUDE waiting_human time (spec approval, code review), so a long validate bar is usually the human, not the machine. Kept metric (pi_flow_run_duration_seconds); the per-state wait breakdown lives on the runs board.
spec.title: Run duration per ticket, stacked by phase

spec.description: One row per phase span; expand a trace to see its phases, click a span id to open the full trace. Step-level spans are on the Step timeline panel above (flow.span = "step"). Traces become fully searchable ~3 min after their last span (Tempo trace_idle_period). Not filtered by $mode: personal traces carry no flow.mode attribute and a =~ match on a missing attribute never hits. Panel time range is pinned to 7d: Tempo trace search returns nothing for ranges >= ~14d (measured: 7d=20 traces, 14d=0) and retention is 14d anyway.
spec.title: Traces by flow.ref (Tempo)

spec.description: Not filtered by $mode: personal traces carry no flow.mode attribute and a =~ match on a missing attribute never hits. Panel time range is pinned to 7d: Tempo trace search returns nothing for ranges >= ~14d (measured: 7d=20 traces, 14d=0) and retention is 14d anyway.
spec.title: Tool failures (click the Span ID to open the trace)
